node.title: L1 official Frobenius-checkpoint Q router
node.statement: Under the official generated-field hypotheses, the order bound, strict field cap, and p>=3583 imply p>=11n/256>n/24. Hence any locator-prefix depth d<=n-1 crosses at most floor(d/p)<=23 positive multiples of the characteristic. For a root set A, replace each power sum S_j at p|j by the elementary checkpoint E_j, retaining S_j at p not dividing j. Newton recursion together with S_(pj)=S_j^p gives a triangular coordinate equivalence between the first d elementary symmetric functions and these d mixed coordinates. Therefore every arbitrary-depth fixed-cofactor locator-prefix cell is exactly a p-free power-sum Q cell conditioned on at most 23 Frobenius checkpoints. Each mixed fiber lies in its coarse p-free fiber, so direct coarse-fiber flatness transfers with no loss. A raw conditional union costs less than n^453 qualitatively but cannot certify the finite q/2^128 threshold once a checkpoint is present. This is a coordinate and accounting router, not a max-fiber or Pade-graph theorem.
